portfolio.title: My Portfolio
portfolio.staleQuote: No live quote - shown at its last known value

trade.title: Trade {{symbol}}
trade.disclaimer: Market order, filled immediately at the price above. HyperStocks trades virtual capital - no real money moves.
trade.depositNote: A deposit is reviewed before it clears - we'll bring you back to this order.
trade.wholeShares: Enter a whole number of shares.
trade.positiveQty: Enter a quantity greater than zero.

withdraw.title: Withdraw
withdraw.intro: Withdrawals are paid in crypto from your cash balance. Anything still invested has to be sold first.
withdraw.sellHint: Sell a position to move its value into cash. Sales fill immediately at the market price - only the withdrawal itself is reviewed.
withdraw.noPositions: You hold no positions - your whole balance is already cash.
withdraw.minimumHint: A withdrawal starts at {{min}}. Sell a position to free up {{missing}} more.
withdraw.addressMismatch: That does not match a {{network}} address.
withdraw.overBalance: That is more than your {{available}} of buying power.
withdraw.overMax: The most that can be withdrawn at once is {{max}}.
withdraw.contactHint: So a reviewer can reach you about this payout.
withdraw.confirmAddress: I have checked this address and it is my {{network}} wallet.
withdraw.holdNote: The amount leaves your balance now and is returned in full if this is cancelled or rejected.
withdraw.unavailableNoNetwork: No payout network is configured on this deployment, so no withdrawal can be issued. An operator has to set DEPOSIT_DESTINATIONS.
withdraw.unavailableDisabled: Withdrawals are switched off on this deployment. An operator has to set WITHDRAWALS_ENABLED before this can be used.

status.requestedBody: The funds are held and a reviewer will process this shortly. You can still cancel it.
status.under_reviewBody: A reviewer is processing this payout. It can no longer be cancelled from here.
status.approvedBody: The transfer has been sent to your wallet.
status.rejectedBody: This payout was not approved and the full amount is back in your balance.
status.cancelledBody: You cancelled this payout. The full amount is back in your balance.

fund.title: Fund account
fund.onChainLead: Send crypto to the address we issue. Deposits are credited after a reviewer verifies the payment.
fund.sentNote: This does not credit your account - it puts the deposit in front of a reviewer.
fund.emailHint: So a reviewer can reach you if the amount received does not match the quote above.
fund.notEnabledBody: No deposit destination is configured on this deployment, so no address can be issued. An operator has to set DEPOSIT_DESTINATIONS.

status.awaiting_paymentBody: Send the exact amount to the address below, then tell us the transaction hash.
status.payment_detectedBody: We have your transaction reference and are checking it against the network.
status.under_reviewBody: A reviewer is verifying your payment. Your balance updates once it is approved.
status.approvedBody: The funds are in your account.
status.expiredBody: No payment was received in time. Start a new deposit to get a fresh reference.

markets.title: Markets
markets.signInWatchlist: Sign in to build a watchlist
markets.delayedHint: Reference price - this venue needs a paid data plan
markets.addHint: on any row to add it here.
markets.blurbStocks: Live quotes on NYSE and NASDAQ. The other six exchanges are delayed reference prices.
markets.blurbCrypto: Live prices for the top 50 by market capitalisation.
markets.blurbForex: Live OANDA rates. The daily change is measured against the ECB reference publication.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.lead: Everything you need to know about investing with Hyperstock.
faq.sub: From opening your account and funding your portfolio to trading, withdrawals, security and supported assets, find answers to the questions investors ask most.
faq.closingBody: Our support team is here to help you understand your account, the platform, and the products available to you.
faq.closingSub: Get the answers you need before you invest.

errors.PRICE_MOVED: The price moved while you were confirming. Check the new total and try again.
errors.INSUFFICIENT_FUNDS: Not enough cash for that movement.
errors.INSUFFICIENT_SHARES: You do not hold that many.
errors.AMOUNT_TOO_LARGE: That amount is above the limit.
errors.BAD_ADDRESS: That is not a valid address for this network.
errors.NO_RATE: No usable price right now - try again in a moment.
errors.NO_DESTINATION: Crypto deposits are not configured on this deployment.
errors.WITHDRAWALS_DISABLED: Withdrawals are not enabled on this deployment.
errors.TOO_MANY_PENDING: You already have too many requests awaiting review.
errors.STALE_STATE: That has already been updated. Refresh and try again.
errors.BAD_TRANSITION: That change is not allowed from the current state.
errors.TX_ALREADY_CLAIMED: That transaction has already been claimed.
errors.ALREADY_REVIEWED: That request has already been reviewed.
errors.BAD_CREDENTIALS: That email and password do not match.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.NETWORK_ERROR: Could not reach HyperStocks. Check your connection and try again.
errors.SERVER_ERROR: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again.
errors.INVALID_OTP: That code is wrong. Check it and try again.
errors.OTP_EXPIRED: That code has expired. Ask for a new one.
errors.TOO_MANY_ATTEMPTS: Too many wrong codes. Ask for a new one.
errors.PROVIDER_NOT_FOUND: That sign-in method is not available right now.

auth.signupLead: Start trading eight exchanges in under a minute.

code.signInLead: We'll email you a six-digit code. No password needed.
code.resetLead: We'll email you a six-digit code to confirm it's you.
code.sentTo: We sent a code to {{email}}. It expires in 10 minutes.
code.label: Code
code.wrong: That code is wrong or has expired.
code.sendFailed: Could not send the code. Try again.

auth.panelBody: Live prices from eight exchanges, virtual capital, and a portfolio that moves the moment an order fills.
auth.point1: Real market data, three asset classes
auth.point3: Not a cent of your own money at risk
auth.termsNotice: By continuing you agree to our <terms>Terms of Service</terms> and <privacy>Privacy Policy</privacy>.

leaderboard.title: Leaderboard
leaderboard.rankedBy: Ranked by {{period}} portfolio value across {{count}} traders.

news.title: News
news.lead: Platform announcements and headlines from the markets you trade.

featured.title: Featured traders
featured.intro: Curated rows on the leaderboard. A featured row is ranked against the live board on the value you enter, so it leads only if that figure is the largest. Nothing here moves money or changes an account.
featured.empty: No featured traders yet. The leaderboard is showing computed rows only.
featured.name: Display name
featured.valueHint: In dollars. This is what the board ranks on.
featured.changeHint: Gain or loss. Negative is allowed.
featured.linkHint: Optional. Linked, this row replaces that account on the board instead of appearing beside it.
featured.wouldLead: This figure would place first on the board.
featured.wouldPlace: This figure would place {{rank}} - the current leader is {{top}}.

approvals.title: Approvals
approvals.intro: Deposits, withdrawals and top-up requests waiting on a reviewer. Approving a deposit or a top-up credits that account; approving a withdrawal records that you sent the funds by hand - nothing here moves anything on a chain.
approvals.reasonHint: Shown to the trader on their own screen.
approvals.txHashHint: Evidence the transfer happened. Required - an approved payout with no hash is a row asserting money left with nothing to check it against.

subscribers.title: Subscribers
subscribers.intro: Addresses captured by the marketing calls to action. Stored here rather than at a form service, so they can be counted against registrations.

users.title: Users
users.intro: Every account on the platform. The Sign-in column is the one that matters: credentials live in `accounts`, so a user row without one ranks on the leaderboard and can never log in.

override.title: Board figures - {{name}}
override.notRanked: This account is not ranked on the leaderboard.
override.valueHint: What the leaderboard will show for this trader.
override.willRank: This figure would place them at rank {{rank}}.
override.changeHint: The cash gain shown beside it is derived from this, never typed separately.
override.note: This changes what the leaderboard displays only. Their cash, positions and portfolio page are untouched, and no money moves.
override.photoHint: PNG, JPEG, WebP or GIF, up to 600KB. Without one the generated mark is used.

notices.marketOpen: US markets are open. Prices are live.
notices.marketClosed: US markets have closed. Prices will not move until the next session.
notices.feedLost: Live price feed disconnected - prices on screen may be out of date.
notices.queueArrived_one: {{count}} new request is waiting for review.
notices.queueArrived_other: {{count}} new requests are waiting for review.

toast.approved: Approved. The account has been credited.
toast.claimed: Claimed. You can now confirm or reject it.
toast.subscribed: Subscribed. You are on the list.
